insight: Bills per second and layers 'Speech Understanding' models — summaries, sentiment, PII redaction — on top of raw transcription.
name: AssemblyAI
description: Speech recognition API with batch and real-time streaming transcription, speaker diarization, and language detection. Its Universal models pair with optional Speech Understanding features (summarization, sentiment, redaction) so a single API can build conversation-intelligence products. Starts with a free credit and pay-as-you-go, per-second billing.
